It also found that Trump's net approval rating among Republicans, a measure of the gap between approval and disapproval, fell 8 percentage points from the previous month.

More than half of registered voters said they are worse off financially since Trump's return to office. [...] The Financial Times/Focaldata poll found similar concerns. Among registered voters, 64 percent disapproved of Trump's handling of inflation and the cost of living, including nearly seven in 10 independents and about one-third of Republicans.

results.title: Poll: Trump’s approval rating falls further among Arizonans

results.content:
Just 39% of registered voters approve of Trump’s job performance, while 58% disapprove, putting him 19 points underwater, as detailed in a Noble Predictive Insights poll released Thursday. The net minus-19 rating drops below his previous low of minus-13, recorded after Jan. 6, 2021.

Trump receives a net minus-25 on both the economy and his handling of military operations in Iran, according to the poll results.
results.title: Trump approval hits all-time low in Arizona poll - KTAR.com
